{
  "name": "ohmail-desktop",
  "version": "1.0.11",
  "private": true,
  "license": "AGPL-3.0-only",
  "engines": {
    "npm": "^10.9.8"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:sqlite": "vitest run --config vitest.sqlite.config.ts",
    "typecheck:mobile": "tsc --noEmit -p apps/mobile/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/mobile/tsconfig.test.json",
    "test:mobile": "node scripts/apply-patches.mjs apply && vitest run apps/mobile/test packages/client-engine/test && vitest run --config vitest.sqlite.config.ts apps/mobile/test",
    "build": "tsc -b",
    "db:setup:prod": "tsx --conditions=ohmail-source packages/db/src/setup-prod-cli.ts"
  },
  "workspaces": [
    "apps/api-vercel",
    "apps/mobile",
    "apps/server",
    "apps/sidecar",
    "apps/webapp",
    "apps/worker",
    "packages/api",
    "packages/client-engine",
    "packages/core",
    "packages/db",
    "packages/db-mail",
    "packages/fixtures",
    "packages/services",
    "packages/tokens",
    "packages/ui",
    "packages/wire"
  ],
  "overrides": {
    "@tiptap/core": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-blockquote": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-bold": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-bubble-menu": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-bullet-list": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-code": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-code-block": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-document": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-dropcursor": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-floating-menu": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-gapcursor": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-hard-break": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-heading": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-horizontal-rule": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-italic": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-link": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-list": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-list-item": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-list-keymap": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-ordered-list": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-paragraph": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-strike": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-text": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extension-underline": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/extensions": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/pm": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/react": "3.31.3",
    "@tiptap/starter-kit": "3.31.3",
    "expo-modules-core@57.0.8": {
      "react-native-worklets": "0.11.4"
    },
    "next@15.5.28": {
      "postcss": "8.5.23"
    },
    "react-native": {
      "react": "19.2.3"
    },
    "vitest": {
      ".": "$vitest",
      "tinypool": "2.2.0"
    }
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "esbuild": "0.24.0",
    "acorn": "8.18.0",
    "vitest": "2.1.9",
    "jsdom": "25.0.1",
    "tsx": "4.23.1",
    "@playwright/test": "1.62.1",
    "typescript": "5.9.3",
    "@types/node": "22.20.1",
    "js-yaml": "4.3.2",
    "semver": "7.8.5",
    "fake-indexeddb": "6.2.5",
    "@testing-library/react": "16.3.2",
    "@types/nodemailer": "6.4.24",
    "@types/mailparser": "3.4.6",
    "@types/sanitize-html": "2.16.1"
  }
}
